review_kind: AI technical review (Codex); no human or native-speaker signoff
review_method: Codex agents reviewed all 59 new local-model UI drafts in each locale. Incorrect technical meanings and omitted instructions were corrected as source-bound targets. Another Codex agent independently reviewed every corrected source/target pair. The two named-group instructions are explicitly AI-authored translations of previously uncatalogued prose, with literal examples retained as placeholders. Standard generator, normalization and translation quality gates remain unchanged.

original_local_model_drafts.source: Add another metadata comparison to this condition box.
original_local_model_drafts.translation: Añadir otra comparación de metadatos a este cuadro de condiciones.

original_local_model_drafts.source: All requires every criterion; any requires at least one criterion.
original_local_model_drafts.translation: Todo requiere de todos los criterios; todo requiere al menos un criterio.

original_local_model_drafts.source: Assign a fixed value, extract text using a capture group, or compose a value from ordered column and text tokens.
original_local_model_drafts.translation: Asigne un valor fijo, extraiga texto usando un grupo de captura, o componga un valor de los tokens de columna y texto ordenados.

original_local_model_drafts.source: Choose a filename or another source or earlier generated column.
original_local_model_drafts.translation: Elija un nombre de archivo u otra fuente o columna generada anteriormente.

original_local_model_drafts.source: Choose a named capture or its number. Group 0 keeps the whole regex match.
original_local_model_drafts.translation: Elija una captura con nombre o su número. El grupo 0 mantiene toda la coincidencia regex.

original_local_model_drafts.source: Copy this example and adapt the separators to your filenames.
original_local_model_drafts.translation: Copia este ejemplo y adapta los separadores a tus nombres de archivo.

original_local_model_drafts.source: Create columns from named groups
original_local_model_drafts.translation: Crear columnas desde grupos nombrados

original_local_model_drafts.source: Create one output column for each named capture, in pattern order. Existing output and source column names are protected.
original_local_model_drafts.translation: Crear una columna de salida para cada captura nombrada, en orden de patrón. Los nombres de columna de origen y de salida existentes están protegidos.

original_local_model_drafts.source: Drag a column into the composition, or double-click to append it. Only source and earlier generated columns are available.
original_local_model_drafts.translation: Arrastre una columna a la composición o haga doble clic para añadirla. Sólo están disponibles las columnas de origen y anteriores.

original_local_model_drafts.source: Enter the text to test. Equals can match an empty string; missing values never match.
original_local_model_drafts.translation: Introduzca el texto a probar. Iguales puede coincidir con una cadena vacía; los valores que faltan nunca coinciden.

original_local_model_drafts.source: Extraction regex
original_local_model_drafts.translation: Extracción regex

original_local_model_drafts.source: Fixed text. Double-click to edit; drag to reorder.
original_local_model_drafts.translation: Texto corregido. Haga doble clic para editar; arrastre para reordenar.

original_local_model_drafts.source: Literal text to insert, such as an underscore, space, or treatment prefix.
original_local_model_drafts.translation: Texto literal para insertar, como subrayado, espacio o prefijo de tratamiento.

original_local_model_drafts.source: Manual rows only
original_local_model_drafts.translation: Únicamente filas manuales

original_local_model_drafts.source: Name the value to assign, then choose which metadata rules must match. You can also drag source rows into a box.
original_local_model_drafts.translation: Nombre el valor a asignar y luego elija qué reglas de metadatos deben coincidir. También puede arrastrar filas de origen en una caja.

original_local_model_drafts.source: Only the regex operators interpret patterns. Other operators compare literal text and are case-sensitive.
original_local_model_drafts.translation: Sólo los operadores regex interpretan patrones. Otros operadores comparan texto literal y son sensibles a casos.

original_local_model_drafts.source: Preview to see source and generated values.
original_local_model_drafts.translation: Vista previa para ver el origen y los valores generados.

original_local_model_drafts.source: Remove this criterion from the condition box.
original_local_model_drafts.translation: Eliminar este criterio de la caja de condiciones.

original_local_model_drafts.source: Source example: {value}
original_local_model_drafts.translation: Ejemplo de fuente: {value}

original_local_model_drafts.source: Text to match
original_local_model_drafts.translation: Texto a combinar

original_local_model_drafts.source: Tokens are joined from left to right. Braces identify column values. Drag to reorder or double-click fixed text to edit it. Missing column values leave the result empty.
original_local_model_drafts.translation: Los tokens se unen de izquierda a derecha. Braces identifican valores de columna. Arrastre para reordenar o haga doble clic en texto fijo para editarlo. Los valores de la columna que faltan dejan el resultado vacío.

original_local_model_drafts.source: Use example
original_local_model_drafts.translation: Ejemplo de uso

original_local_model_drafts.source: all rules match
original_local_model_drafts.translation: todas las reglas coinciden

original_local_model_drafts.source: any rule matches
original_local_model_drafts.translation: cualquier regla coincide
